# IServerInput.timeout property

How long this server may go unheard, in milliseconds, as announced to a discovering cluster manager — [UDPClusterManager](/api/core/latest/core.udpclustermanager/) sets it from the interval carried by the server's announcement. Static `cluster` entries leave it out.

**Signature:**

```typescript
timeout?: number;
```

## Remarks

[ClusteredRedisQueue](/api/core/latest/core.clusteredredisqueue/) uses it as the interval at which it asks a server kept after its announcements lapsed whether it still answers, never less than one second, and one second where it is missing.
